answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 15437 Country: Canada Title: ASA Brother, Is it allowable to clean throat and cleanse nose three times during Farz-e-Ghusl which is usually done after sex or semens extracting out during sleep.? Your urgent reply is awaited. Nauman Question: ASA Brother, Is it allowable to clean throat and cleanse nose three times during Farz-e-Ghusl which is usually done after sex or semens extracting out during sleep.? Your urgent reply is awaited. Nauman Answer ID: 15437 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1344/1344=M/1430) In obligatory ghusl it is fardh (obligatory) to rinse mouth and nose. By cleaning throat if you mean to gargle, it is not fardh rather sunnah. Likewise, rinsing the mouth and nose thrice is sunnah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
